_comment: The test questions from 01-basic-rag, unchanged. None of them appears in the training data: the training set covers the same facts in different words, and each answerable question's training counterpart is marked with 'twin' in training_qa.json. Test questions. 'answerable' questions are answered by the help center: 'relevant' lists the article(s) that contain the answer (any one of them is enough), and 'patterns' are regular expressions, at least one of which must match a reply that contains the key fact. The patterns were checked against a hand reading of every reply; read replies yourself too, because a pattern can't tell a right answer from a wrong one that mentions the same fact. 'not_in_docs' questions sound like support questions, but the help center doesn't answer them; the right behavior is to decline.
